what: Pin a full-bleed photo stage and stretch the track by the number of slides (.5 + 1.5×count + .5 screens). From the second slide on, each one covers from below every 1.5 screens — the slide moves yPercent 100→0 and its inner moves −100→0 together (ease none, scrub true), so it is revealed like a curtain lifting. Photos drift through the whole stage at scale 1.2→1.3, from yPercent 10 on the first and 30 on the others to −10 on the last and −30 on the others. For each slide, during its first 1 screen, fx:slide {index, active, progress} Fire it to tie together the chart frame and text entrance over the photo

options.lead · tail: Screens held in front and behind, default .5 · .5 (if you add a one-line closing act at the end, set tail to 2)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Section — from the second on, it covers from below (required)
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: (If present) inner section — moves in reverse to give the feel of a curtain lifting
options.[data-fx-part=image]: (If present) section photo — drifts upward from 1.2 to 1.3x

use:
00%

…
· el.addEventListener("fx:slide", e => player.setFrame(e.detail.progress * frames))

from.where: index.html .ow-cine (three photo stages + a one-line curtain) · article.html .ar-cine (stages with a different background per Section) — original cinematic-scroll: panel height .5+1.5p+.5(+1+.5), data-slide yPercent 100 · data-slide-inner −100, duration 1 placed at (t−1)×1.5+.5, photo IMAGE_START_END_OFFSET 10 · IMAGE_MIDDLE_OFFSET 30 · IMAGE_SCALE 1.2→1.3, Lottie setFrame(progress × totalFrames) top+1.5i·vh → top+(1+1.5i)·vh

note: The closing one-line curtain (background panel 0→.76 · stage 1→.75, scrub .5) and the stage entrance (.5→1) live in OW.cinematic in the site’s shared.js
